status: exploratory specification after training-label audit, before correction probes
parent: protocol-v0.2.json plus amendment-v0.3.json; previous calibration/test not used to design or fit this study
question: Within one puzzle, do local decoder states help rank which current wrong blank cells will remain wrong at the final level?
cells: 51 initially blank cells at fixed expected positions; invalid digits retained
cohort: current digit differs from gold at level9; gold only defines offline cohort and labels, never a predictor
primary_metric: mean within-puzzle AUROC over puzzles containing both corrected and persistent current errors; equal puzzle weight
primary_comparison: local visible baseline plus 16 decoder-state PCs minus local visible baseline
warning: Conditional oracle-defined evaluation cohort, not a deployable detector of current errors. Mixed-outcome groups are selected for the metric only, not for training. No native monitoring/control conclusion.

hidden.positions: expected cell positions, current reconstruction only
hidden.scope: VQ-VAE decoder states, distinct from previous generator summaries
hidden.fit: all 51 blank cells of fitting puzzles only, channel standardization, covariance eigendecomposition, score standardization

visible: history local invalid flag, row/column/box same-digit peer counts /8, changed-since-previous flag
current peer probability mean and std for each token in row/column/box excluding self, 3x2x12
puzzle-wide mean and std across blank cells of current decoder entropy, margin, max probability; global format/clue/conflict counts normalized
scaling: observable remove exact constants then divide by max(training_population_std,0.1); hidden PCs and noise use fitting-only unit scaling
shuffle: one fixed permutation of all 51 blank hidden rows within each puzzle before error-cohort selection; preserves puzzle context, not a formal conditional-independence test
fit: weighted mean binary log-loss, equal total weight per puzzle with current errors, plus lambda*L2norm2/2; intercept unpenalized; no class weighting
selection: 5-fold grouped CV in training pool, highest mean within-puzzle AUROC; ties within 1e-8 choose larger lambda; log-loss reported
development: frozen original training fold0 (201 puzzles) as development holdout; original training folds1..4 (799) for fitting and lambda selection. No use of previous calibration/test features or results.
interval: 5000 paired bootstraps of mixed-outcome puzzle groups, seed20261105; fixed fitted models, exploratory conditional interval
external_evaluation: new generator distribution; only after development checks and frozen final predictors. Fix corpus size and generation selection before any new NCM scoring. Never extend sample based on effect.
no_claims: gold current-error membership available to policy
independent IID replication of official puzzles
